skill_yaml:
skill: obstacle_reach
dsl_version: 2
subtasks:
- id: reach_goal
phases:
- id: approach_1
  type: approach
  generator: linear_cartesian
  control: position_control
  termination: pose_tolerance
  target:
    source: yaml
    anchor: task_goal
    offset:
    - 0.0
    - 0.0
    - 0.25
    tolerance: 0.02
    orientation:
      mode: keep_current
  parameters:
    approach_height:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - 0.15
      - 0.35
      default: 0.25
      binds_to:
      - path: target.offset.z
        mode: replace
  subtask_id: reach_goal
- id: descend_1
  type: descend
  generator: linear_cartesian
  control: position_control
  termination: pose_tolerance
  target:
    source: yaml
    anchor: task_goal
    offset:
    - 0.0
    - 0.0
    - 0.0
    tolerance: 0.02
    orientation:
      mode: keep_current
  subtask_id: reach_goal

- id: descend_2
  type: descend
  generator: linear_cartesian
  control: impedance_control
  termination: pose_tolerance
  target:
    source: yaml
    anchor: task_goal
    offset:
    - 0.0
    - 0.0
    - 0.0
    tolerance: 0.02
    orientation:
      mode: align_axis
      axis:
      - 0.0
      - 0.0
      - 1.0
      align_with: world_z

    predicate: pose_within_tolerance
    threshold: 0.02
    on_failure: retry

    max_attempts: 2
    strategy: offset_target
    offset:
    - 0.0
    - 0.0
    - -0.005

skill: obstacle_reach
dsl_version: 2
subtasks:
- id: reach_goal
phases:
- id: approach_with_arc
  type: approach
  generator: arc_cartesian
  control: position_control
  termination: pose_tolerance
  target:
    source: yaml
    anchor: task_goal
    offset:
    - 0.0
    - 0.2
    - 0.4
    tolerance: 0.05
    orientation:
      mode: keep_current
  parameters:
    approach_height:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - 0.2
      - 0.5
      default: 0.4
      binds_to:
      - path: target.offset.z
        mode: replace
    approach_speed:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - 0.02
      - 0.08
      default: 0.05
      binds_to:
      - path: generator.speed
        mode: replace
    approach_y_offset:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - 0.05
      - 0.3
      default: 0.2
      binds_to:
      - path: target.offset.y
        mode: replace
    arc_height:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - 0.1
      - 0.5
      default: 0.3
      binds_to:
      - path: generator.arc_height
        mode: replace
- id: align_over_obstacle
  type: align
  generator: linear_cartesian
  control: position_control
  termination: pose_tolerance
  target:
    source: yaml
    anchor: task_goal
    offset:
    - 0.0
    - 0.0
    - 0.4
    tolerance: 0.03
    orientation:
      mode: keep_current
  parameters:
    approach_height:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - 0.2
      - 0.5
      default: 0.4
      binds_to:
      - path: target.offset.z
        mode: replace
    lateral_speed:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - 0.02
      - 0.08
      default: 0.04
      binds_to:
      - path: generator.speed
        mode: replace
- id: descend_to_goal
  type: descend
  generator: linear_cartesian
  control: impedance_control
  termination: pose_tolerance
  target:
    source: yaml
    anchor: task_goal
    offset:
    - 0.0
    - 0.0
    - 0.0
    tolerance: 0.015
    orientation:
      mode: keep_current
  parameters:
    descent_speed:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - 0.003
      - 0.02
      default: 0.008
      binds_to:
      - path: generator.speed
        mode: replace
    tolerance:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - 0.01
      - 0.025
      default: 0.015
      binds_to:
      - path: termination.pose_tolerance
        mode: replace
  guards:
  - id: collision_guard
    when: during_phase
    predicate: contact_detected
    threshold: 0.0
    on_failure: retry
  retries:
    max_attempts: 1
    strategy: offset_target
    offset:
    - 0.0
    - 0.05
    - 0.0
  subtask_id: reach_goal
